Mod.Name: Precise Temperature Control
Mod.Author: NyanDoggo
Mod.Description: Set the Heating Plate's target temperature to the exact degree, with or without Chemical Equipment Modules: -/+ change it by 1 °C, Shift-click by 10 °C. The plate heats up to the target, stops there and holds it exactly. Max temperature (99 °C without modules, 160 °C with) and heating speed still depend on the modules.
